682:t_1:4.en:
$$ブライト$$
「First of all, I'd like us to share our joy together at having made it to the galactic center...」

682:t_1:8.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「But the battle from here on is the very mission laid upon us.」

682:t_1:11.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「$$バアル$$... the battle against the $$宇宙怪獣$$... We will launch the final operation of that battle in 48 hours.」

682:t_1:12.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「The $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ report that the $$宇宙怪獣$$, now spawning in huge numbers, are appearing in every star region of the Milky Way and have begun invading.」

682:t_1:13.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「So you mean the all-out attack is starting to get underway...」

682:t_1:14.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「As that damage spreads, data has been observed showing that space is gradually becoming distorted.」

682:t_1:16.en:
$$トライア$$
「You could also call it a distortion of the dimensional boundary line over an extremely wide area.」

682:t_1:17.en:
$$赤木$$
「Are you saying a $$時空震動|lc$$ big enough to envelop the entire universe is going to happen!?」

682:t_1:18.en:
$$桂$$
「So it's a spacetime collapse... That's the great collapse of the universe that comes once every 120 million years, huh?」

682:t_1:19.en:
$$トライア$$
「Probably, yes... And the point where those distortions converge is the gravitational anomaly at the galactic center... the so-called Great Attractor.」

682:t_1:20.en:
$$タケル$$
「The Great Attractor... So that's the core of the great collapse...」

682:t_1:21.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Is there some connection between the $$宇宙怪獣$$ starting their all-out attack and the distortion of space syncing up with it?」

682:t_1:22.en:
$$テッサ$$
「The key to that lies in the $$時空修復|lc$$ that $$レナード・テスタロッサ$$ attempted.」

682:t_1:23.en:
$$宗介$$
「Remaking the world however one pleases... A forced $$時空修復|lc$$, then...」

682:t_1:25.en:
$$トライア$$
「Looks like some of you have figured it out.」

682:t_1:26.en:
$$テッサ$$
「He tried to carry it out after first reducing the living humans who act as resistance to the $$時空修復|lc$$... the so-called power of life.」

682:t_1:27.en:
$$万丈$$
「A mechanism where wiping out living beings weakens the power of life and sets off a $$時空震動|lc$$... Is the great collapse of the universe the same?」

682:t_1:28.en:
$$葵$$
「The force that seeks to exist and the force that seeks to vanish... So what produces the force that seeks to exist is the life living in this universe, right?」

682:t_1:29.en:
$$トライア$$
「Strictly speaking, though, the power of life doesn't belong only to living creatures.」

682:t_1:30.en:
$$トライア$$
「Everything that exists holds the will that governs it. Push it far enough and you can say that even the principles and laws of this world come from the will of that force of existence.」

682:t_1:32.en:
$$トライア$$
「...I'll tell you about that eventually. It's important, so we'll take our time with it...」

682:t_1:33.en:
$$トライア$$
「But first, dealing with the situation in front of us comes first.」

682:t_1:34.en:
$n
(There's a power of life in things other than living creatures...)

682:t_1:35.en:
$$カズミ$$
「And the $$宇宙怪獣$$ lay their eggs on stars...」

682:t_1:36.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「I've heard stars are lumps of $$次元力|lc$$. So that means they're also aggregates of the power of life, right?」

682:t_1:37.en:
$$號$$
「By wiping out living beings and stars, they weaken the force that seeks to exist, and the paired force that seeks to vanish swallows up the universe...」

682:t_1:38.en:
$$アポロ$$
「So that's the great collapse of the universe, huh?」

682:t_1:39.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Could the $$御使い$$s' destruction of the galaxy be...」

682:t_1:40.en:
$$トライア$$
「Yeah... It's probably the same mechanism.」

682:t_1:41.en:
$$宗介$$
「The 'preparations' they talk about means taking the lives of those who live there...」

682:t_1:42.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「So the forces for that purpose are those $$アンゲロイ・アルカ$$ and the $$エル・ミレニウム$$...」

682:t_1:43.en:
$$シモン$$
「Damn...! They're sickening all the way through!」

682:t_1:44.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Forget the $$御使い$$s for now. Concentrate on the fight against the $$宇宙怪獣$$.」

682:t_1:47.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「I've been wondering for a while, but what does that force that seeks to vanish want to do?」

682:t_1:48.en:
$$勝平$$
「I was wondering that too! If everything vanishes, then that force that seeks to vanish vanishes too, right?」

682:t_1:49.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Exactly! What's the point of that!」

682:t_1:50.en:
$$隼人$$
「An existence that does not exist... In other words, nothingness...」

682:t_1:51.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Unfortunately, even I can't answer the question $$ワッ太$$ and $$勝平$$ have.」

682:t_1:53.en:
$$トライア$$
「Answering that would mean wading into the realm of philosophy, but...」

682:t_1:54.en:
$$トライア$$
「If you want my own interpretation, I'd say nothingness is also a kind of will.」

682:t_1:56.en:
$$トライア$$
「Meaning that even in a world where the force that seeks to vanish has erased everything, only the will of whoever wished for it remains.」

682:t_1:58.en:
$$トライア$$
「Existing even though there's nothing... The super-existence of one who can perceive that existence... It's hard to explain and hard to understand.」

682:t_1:59.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「'I think, therefore I am'... huh...」

682:t_1:60.en:
$$キラ$$
「If the force that seeks to vanish is a will, is it some kind of living creature?」

682:t_1:61.en:
$$トライア$$
「Who knows... At the very least, I doubt it's the kind of creature we recognize.」

682:t_1:62.en:
$$トライア$$
「If I had to put a name to it, I suppose I'd call it the will of the universe.」

682:t_1:63.en:
$$シン$$
「Then it's because the universe itself wants to vanish that it creates the $$宇宙怪獣$$!?」

682:t_1:64.en:
$n
「...Rather than wanting to vanish, I think it means it wants to be reborn...」

682:t_1:66.en:
$$トライア$$
「It's just as $n says. For the sake of its own rebirth, the universe must want to die once.」

682:t_1:67.en:
$$トライア$$
「What that's all for is probably a different story, though.」

682:t_1:68.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Let's leave the hard talk there. We live in that universe, and if it tells us to get out for its own convenience, that's a problem for us.」

682:t_1:69.en:
$$アルト$$
「To save the lives that exist, we have to stop the great collapse.」

682:t_1:70.en:
$$ロラン$$
「That's why we came all the way here.」

682:t_1:71.en:
$$葵$$
「Whether our opponent is the universe or whatever, let's go show it what we've got.」

682:t_1:72.en:
$$甲児$$
「As representatives of the living, we're here prepared to challenge the universe.」

682:t_1:73.en:
$$ブライト$$
「That's right. That is our reason for fighting.」

682:t_1:74.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「As our collaborators, the various ultra-long-range emigrant fleets we've long been approaching, starting with the $$マクロス７船団$$, and...」

682:t_1:75.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「the forces of the worlds once under the rule of the $$ギシン星$$ system, which $$ロゼ$$ mediated for us, will also join the operation.」

682:t_1:76.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「If we'd had a little more time, we could have made contact with people from more star systems and asked for their cooperation...」

682:t_1:77.en:
$$トライア$$
「It seems the other star systems have no knowledge of the mechanism behind the great collapse of the universe.」

682:t_1:78.en:
$$タケル$$
「So that's why they're concentrating on protecting their own worlds...」

682:t_1:79.en:
$$レド$$
「What are the $$サイデリアル$$ doing? They must have been fighting $$バアル$$ in the galactic core too.」

682:t_1:80.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Judging from their movements, they seem to have suffered repeated routs and been greatly weakened.」

682:t_1:81.en:
$$シャア$$
「The cause appears to be disorder in their chain of command after the defection of $$皇帝アウストラリス$$, who ruled them.」

682:t_1:82.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$次元将ヴィルダーク#pilot$$, huh...」
